model.name: FederationApi.importScenario
model.description: Receiver-side federation import: POST /api/federation/import — reads a federated-ref, fetches the unit/children/bytes from the origin (via R26.3), runs lazy-resolve (R26.4) + conflict-reconcile (R26.5), and lands the transfer locally. The wiring that connects T26.1-T26.5 into the drop flow (v0.7.7).
